Complete occluded, back, side and underside regions using {'type': 'repeated_modules', 'completionRule': '按竖向条纹规律重复延伸完整毯面'} and ['按可见编织纹理补全遮挡区域']. Texture rule: 竖向条纹编织纹理，颗粒感强; 延续竖向条纹编织纹理，无空白间隙. Target plausible real-world dimensions are approximately 1.30 m wide, 1.90 m deep and 0.02 m high. Preserve the corresponding width-to-depth-to-height proportions. Use conservative category structure, repeated modules, continuous closed geometry, and one 45-degree product view on a plain light background. Keep only the main object.
